title: Anthropic pauses its plan to move Claude Agent SDK to token-based billing from June 15, saying "Nothing changes for now", giving power users a pricing reprieve (Kyle Orland/Ars Technica)
summary: Kyle Orland / Ars Technica: Anthropic pauses its plan to move Claude Agent SDK to token-based billing from June 15, saying “Nothing changes for now”, giving power users a pricing reprieve — On Monday, though, Anthropic abruptly announced it had paused those pricing changes just as they were set to take effect …
